info.title: Eunomia DS Agent API
info.description: Every HTTP route of a monolith agent: management APIs, Dataspace Protocol 2025-1 endpoints, SSI auth, OAuth, events, keystore and dataplane. Generated by `scripts/build-openapi.py` from the per-agent specs in this folder; do not edit.

get.description:
Only `response_type=code` with a `code_challenge` is supported. Without `user_id`, the
user is taken from the bearer token when one is sent.

post.description:
Grants: `password`, `client_credentials` (secret via HTTP Basic or body, or a
`private_key_jwt` client assertion), `authorization_code` (PKCE), `refresh_token` and
`urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer`. Without `grant_type` it is inferred from the
fields present.
Always answers 200, whether or not the token was known.
An invalid or unknown token answers `{"active": false}`.

Unnamed server-sent events, one `EventEnvelope` JSON per `data:` line, with a keep-alive
every 15 s, about the records the session's user sees. The session travels as the
proxy's cookie, like any other request.

get.description:
Any method is forwarded to the upstream of the process egress config, with the
connector credentials resolved from the keystore. Bodies over 2 MiB are rejected, and
the upstream must answer within 30 s. Not behind OAuth: only STARTED processes answer.

200.description: Upstream response, relayed as is (any status)

400.description: Id is not a URN, or body too large (plain text)

500.description: Lookup failed or egress not proxyable (plain text)

KeyPath.name: key
KeyPath.description: Entry key without its leading `/`; may contain further `/` segments.

KeyPrefix.name: prefix
KeyPrefix.description: Only entries whose key starts with this prefix.

PageNumber.name: page
PageNumber.description: 1-based page index for offset paging, used when no cursor is sent.

PidPath.name: id
PidPath.description: This agent's process id (`providerPid` on a provider, `consumerPid` on a consumer).

ProxyDataPlaneId.name: dataPlaneId
ProxyDataPlaneId.description: URN of a STARTED dataplane process.

TenantHeader.name: x-tenant-id
TenantHeader.description: Tenant to act on. Non-admins may only name their own tenant.

TopicPattern.name: topic
TopicPattern.description: Topic pattern; `*` matches one segment, `**` any number of them.

Conflict.description: The resource already exists or changed

Forbidden.description: The caller may not act on this tenant or resource

PeerUnauthorized.description: Missing or unknown peer token (empty body)

ProtocolBadRequest.description: Invalid message or failed request, as plain text

RpcNegotiationError.description: Invalid request, or the peer or this agent rejected the message

ConnectorInstanceDto.description: Instance metadata, flattened, plus its resolved configuration.

parameters.description: Values by parameter name; undeclared names are ignored.

ConnectorTemplateDto.description: Template metadata, flattened, plus its parameterised sections.

parameters.description: One declaration per placeholder used in the template.

ContextField.description: JSON-LD context; must include the DSP 2024-1 or 2025-1 context.

expiresAt.description: Without it the token never expires.

visibility.description: Who else sees it; private by default.

tenantId.description: Tenant of the user, which is also its identifier.

extraFields.description: Free-form JSON stored with the user.

endpoint.description: Optional; a pull request may get it in the start message.

ingressConfig.description: Where data enters the dataplane, any JSON value.

egressConfig.description: Where data leaves the dataplane, any JSON value.

flowControl.description: Flow control settings, any JSON value.

fields.description: Extra key/value fields of the process.

dcatAccessService.description: URN of the data service serving it.

DspCatalog.description: DCAT catalog as sent over DSP.

service.description: One data service, a minimized one, or a list.

DspDataService.description: Full data service, or a minimized one with only `@type`, `@id` and DCAT fields.

ErrorInfo.description: Error body returned by every agent.

error_code.description: Internal error code of the failure kind.

user_id.description: Owner of the record ("system" if a peer opened it).

role.description: Role the record was created under (or that handles it).

correlation_id.description: URN shared by the events of one flow.

user_id.description: Owner of the record ("system" if a peer opened it).

role.description: Role the record was created under (or that handles it).

secret.description: Write-only HMAC key; shows as `*****` when set, null otherwise.

GnapGrantRequest.description: GNAP grant request asking for an access token or a credential.

interact.description: Interaction start methods and finish callback.

GnapGrantResponse.description: Pending (interaction needed), processing, approved or error response.

KeystoreApplicationConfig.description: One optional section per agent, as loaded from the config file.

value.description: New secret content, any JSON value.

LocalizedText.description: A plain string, or the same text in several languages.

NegotiationMessageDto.description: Message with the offer or agreement it carried.

payload.description: The DSP message as sent or received.

NegotiationProcessDto.description: Negotiation with its identifiers, messages, offers and agreement.

catalogId.description: Defaults to the tenant's main catalog.

accessServiceId.description: Defaults to the tenant's main data service.

policy.description: A single-permission ODRL offer on the dataset.

entityId.description: URN of the entity that receives the offer.

user_id.description: User the code is issued for; defaults to the bearer's subject.

username.description: `password` grant: the user's tenant id or email.

assertion.description: Signed JWT for the jwt-bearer grant (RFC 7523).

extraFields.description: Free-form JSON stored with the user.

OAuthUserInfo.description: `sub`, email and role, plus the user's extra fields at the top level.

OdrlMessageOffer.description: Offer inside a negotiation message; `target` is required.

OdrlOfferReference.description: Offer referenced only by its id.

entity.description: URN of the entity the offer is attached to.

instantiationParameters.description: Parameters used when the offer came from a template.

OdrlPolicyInfo.description: Rules of a policy without its identity or target.

token.description: Token this agent holds for calling the participant.

PeerCatalogEntry.description: A peer and its cached catalog.

values.description: Allowed values of a selection, plain or labelled.

keys_id.description: Ids of wallet keys bound as verification methods.

filter.description: Filter forwarded in the catalog request, any JSON value.

noCache.description: Skip storing the answer in the peer catalog cache.

providerAddress.description: The consumer's DSP negotiation base URL.

callbackAddress.description: This agent's DSP negotiation base URL.

RpcNegotiationPidsDto.description: Identifies the negotiation for acceptance, agreement, verification or finalization.

providerAddress.description: The provider's DSP negotiation base URL.

callbackAddress.description: This agent's DSP negotiation base URL.

SecretString.description: Where a credential is stored; `content` may hold placeholders.

TemplateMapString.description: A string map, or one placeholder resolving to a map.

TemplateVecString.description: A list of strings, or one placeholder resolving to a list.

canonicalForm.description: URDNA2015 canonical N-Quads of a JSON-LD message.

canonicalHash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the canonical form.

payload.description: The protocol message as sent or received.

format.description: `dct:format` of a distribution of the agreement's target.

TransferRole.description: Capitalised forms are accepted on input.

TransferStateMetadata.description: Attribute, reasons and code of the current state, such as a termination cause.

VcTypeConfig.description: Credential type and format joined by `_`, with `:` in the type written as `_`.

path.description: Path where the DSP version is mounted.

serviceId.description: URN derived from the DSP path, stable across restarts.

Visibility.description:
Who else sees a record beyond those its role lets in: nobody (Private), everyone without
its author (Anonymous), or everyone (Public).

vc_body.description: The credential as issued (JWT or JSON-LD).

bearerAuth.description: OAuth access token (JWT) or personal access token issued by `/oauth`.

peerBearer.description: Token the peer obtained from this agent through GNAP onboarding.
